annotations.title: Job status · Mark applied, saved or dismissed

description: [Job status] Record a job's status on the user's job list: applied, saved or dismissed. Applied is for an application the user submitted themselves. It also records the job on the Tracker: it creates the job's one Tracker entry, or moves its saved or contacted entry to applied, and returns trackerEntry (created, linked, moved, existing, skipped or failed; a failed Tracker step is safe to repeat). Saved and dismissed change only the job list and never the Tracker. Later outcomes go on the Tracker: interview, offer, rejected or withdrawn with trackly_update_tracker_stage, and a pause with trackly_add_tracker_note.

context.description: Briefly explain why this tool helps the current job-search goal. Never include resume text, profile answers, demographic or work-authorization answers, application notes, credentials, or secrets.
